liverefresh.title: Live Refresh
liverefresh.remarks: Indicates whether live refresh of cache is supported for this property.

maxtype.title: Data Type
maxtype.remarks: Maximo data type for values of this property (ALN, INTEGER, YORN)

masked.title: Masked
masked.remarks: Identified whether this value is masked in the System Properties application

domainid.title: Domain
domainid.remarks: The validation domain for values of this property.

cachedvalue.title: Current Value
cachedvalue.remarks: The current value of this property used by this server instance.

globalonly.title: Global Only
globalonly.remarks: Indicates whether this property must exist only at a system-wide level.  If true, this property cannot have an instance-specific value.

instanceonly.title: Instance Only
instanceonly.remarks: Indicates whether this property must be defined only at the instance level.  If true, an instance-specific value must be defined for each servername and there will be no global value.

nullsallowed.title: Nulls Allowed
nullsallowed.remarks: Indicates whether a null value is permitted on MaxPropValue for this property.

onlinechanges.title: Online Changes Allowed
onlinechanges.remarks: Indicates whether the user is allowed to override the value via the Property application.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: The User ID who last changed this row.

changedate.title: Change Date
changedate.remarks: The timestamp of the last changed applied to this row.

encrypted.title: Encrypted
encrypted.remarks: Indicates whether the value of the property should be encrypted when stored on the MaxPropValue table.

securelevel.title: Security Level
securelevel.remarks: Indicates the level of access permitted for this property

maximodefault.title: Maximo Default
maximodefault.remarks: The default value used in a new Maximo installation.  This supports refreshing all properties with the system defaults.

userdefined.title: User Defined
userdefined.remarks: Indicates whether this property was delivered with Maximo or was defined by a user.
